newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower on CBOT pressure.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower on CBOT pressure.

text.p: A late burst of broad-based selling in CBOT wheat spilled over and pressured MGE spring wheat futures to close lower, traders said.
CBOT traders said wheat was pressured by a rumor that Egypt canceled a U.S. wheat shipment.

"There was big spread trade in here today," a MGE trader said. "Most of our strength early was spread trade and buying of the Dec, but all that stuff dried up late in the session and all our buy paper was canceled when Chicago tanked."
MGE spring wheat had been supported by mill buying and active bull-spreading at the midsession, traders said.
MGE spring wheat closed 2-1/2 to 8-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 8-3/4 cents at $4.13-1/2.

Benson-Quinn and LFG each bull-spread two million Dec/March bushels at between 10 and 12 cents. CIS and Country Hedging each bear-spread one million March/Dec. LFG bought one million Dec and sold 2.5 million Dec late. BQ and Wilson sold one million Dec and CIS sold two million Dec, traders said.
The MGE estimated Wednesday's spring wheat volume at 30.196 million bushels, up from 21.537 million on Tuesday.
MGE barley futures did not trade Wednesday.
